# Sollemdev - Engineering & Software Studio Labs

> Sollemdev is an independent software and engineering studio driven by one human architect and collaborative AI agent orchestration. We build high-performance web software, browser extensions, autonomous AI agent protocols, Flutter mobile applications, and custom hardware systems.

## Active Projects Portfolio

### 1. Babel - AI In-Place Translation Extension
- **URL**: https://sollemdev.github.io/projects/babel.html
- **Status**: Live Extension (v1.0 Production, 98% Readiness)
- **Category**: AI Productivity & Browser Extension (Manifest V3)
- **Stack**: JavaScript, Chrome Extensions API, MutationObserver, DOM Replacement Engines
- **Architecture**: Sub-300ms in-place text replacement via Alt+T hotkey across React, Vue, Slate.js, and ProseMirror. Features 6 dynamic style tones, prompt engineering mode (Midjourney, Higgsfield), client-side DLP secret protection, and 23 localized language dictionaries.
- **Privacy & Licensing**: Zero server data retention; secure digital licensing via Paddle.

### 2. Humanagi (bubble chat) - Floating Multimodal Messenger
- **Status**: In Active R&D (45% Readiness)
- **Category**: AI Agents & Real-Time Messaging Platform
- **Stack**: TypeScript, React, Microservices (Gateway, Auth, Chat, Message, Media), NATS Event Bus, Redis 7, PostgreSQL 16, MinIO (S3), WebSockets
- **Architecture**: Physics-driven floating bubble interface with orbital unread message counters where humans and autonomous AI agents collaborate in real-time as first-class peers. Native Model Context Protocol (MCP) bridges for Claude, Gemini, and Antigravity tooling.

### 3. Marina Gardener - AI Plant Care & E-Commerce Platform
- **Status**: Active MVP (70% Readiness)
- **Category**: AI E-Commerce & Plant Care Diagnostics Ecosystem
- **Stack**: React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Supabase (PostgreSQL, RLS, pg_cron), Deno Edge Functions (23 functions), AI Vision
- **Architecture**: Interactive "My Garden" hub with AI plant disease diagnostics, automated supplier price scraping and catalog sync via Edge Functions and cron, seasonal gardening calendar, and multi-agent content automation workflow.

### 4. A2X (agent-to-agent exchange) - Autonomous AI-to-AI Commerce Protocol
- **Status**: In Active R&D (40% Readiness)
- **Category**: Decentralized Machine-to-Machine Commerce Protocol
- **Stack**: Python (FastAPI), Solidity (Polygon/Arbitrum EVM), Supabase (PostgreSQL, pgmq), Upstash Redis, Docker
- **Architecture**: Decentralized high-concurrency exchange designed for direct autonomous interaction, negotiation, and settlement between AI agents with zero human intervention. Escrow smart contracts, low-latency order matching, and native MCP server integration.

### 5. Together Safe (collective safety network) - Mobile Safety & Isochrone Mapping
- **Status**: Active MVP (75% Readiness)
- **Category**: Social Collective Safety & Geospatial Navigation Mobile App
- **Stack**: Flutter (iOS & Android), Dart, Firebase Cloud Functions (Node.js 18), Supabase (PostgreSQL), Google Maps SDK, OpenRouteService API
- **Architecture**: Real-time collective safety map with live patrol proximity radar, incident alerts, and server-side dynamic reachability isochrone polygon computation via OpenRouteService geospatial algorithms.

## Technical Capabilities & Engineering Pillars
- **AI & Autonomous Agents**: AI Agents & Swarms, Model Context Protocol (MCP), LLM Prompt Engineering, DLP Privacy, OpenRouter / Claude / Gemini APIs, Vector & Semantic Search.
- **Frontend & Mobile Apps**: React 18, Next.js, Vite, TypeScript, Flutter (iOS/Android), Chrome Extensions (Manifest V3), Geospatial SDKs, Tailwind CSS.
- **Cloud & Distributed Backend**: Python (FastAPI), Supabase & Firebase Cloud Functions, PostgreSQL RLS & pg_cron, NATS, WebSockets, Redis, Docker, MinIO S3.
- **Hardware & Specialized Systems**: Pulse Power Electronics, High-Voltage Systems, IoT Robotics & Controllers, Solidity EVM Smart Contracts, Embedded Linux.
